from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util, py_compile
ROOT=Path.cwd()
SRC=ROOT/'control/bridge_commands/command_bus_poller.py'
py_compile.compile(str(SRC), doraise=True)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('bus_recovery_e007', SRC)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
assert spec.loader is not None
spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
cmd={'schema':'PREDICTION_BRIDGE_COMMAND_V1','task_id':'HEADLESS-E007-SOURCE','action':'BRIDGE_PING','created_at_utc':'2026-10-01T06:40:00Z','delivery_mode':'headless','live_trading':False,'paid_actions':False,'wallet_actions':False,'intelligence_tier':'C','issuer':{'model':'GPT-5.6 Sol','reasoning_level':'UNAVAILABLE_TO_RUNTIME'}}

assert ok and reason=='OK', (ok,reason)
route,source=mod.resolve_route(cmd)
assert source=='headless' and route=={'chat_id':'HEADLESS_CONTROL','consumer_id':None}, (route,source)
bad=dict(cmd, route_task_id='SESSION-ROUTE-BAD')
ok,reason=mod.validate_command(bad)
assert not ok and reason=='HEADLESS_ROUTE_FORBIDDEN', (ok,reason)
